  1. Work

INNA AI — a platform for voice and text AI agents

A 24/7 AI agent for companies, a personal AI assistant and a coaching API that analyses calls — on one multi-tenant platform.

Client
Our own product
Industry
Artificial intelligence, customer service
Status
Built
Year
2026

Challenge

Customer requests arrive day and night by phone, Telegram and other channels, and operators cannot answer all of them quickly. Checking call quality by hand takes a lot of time too.

Solution

An AI agent working over the phone (Twilio, SIP.uz), Telegram and Slack: it answers from the company’s knowledge base, makes outbound calls and collects leads.

A low-latency voice pipeline: calls are processed in real time over WebSocket.

On the consumer side, a personal AI assistant with long-term memory, tasks and calendar integration.

The coaching API analyses every call and returns a quality score and recommendations for the operator. The Telegram bot works as one of the agent’s channels.

Result

After a retail company introduced 24/7 automatic answers over Telegram and phone, response time fell by 80% and customer satisfaction rose by 40%.

After the coaching API and quality scoring were introduced, sales efficiency rose by 35%. AI Persona users became 60% more productive.

One core, three products.

  • AI Agent (B2B)

    Phone, Telegram and Slack channels, outbound calls, leads and a live monitoring dashboard.

  • AI Persona (B2C)

    Memory, tasks, scheduled reminders, calendar and email integration.

  • Coaching API

    Call analysis, quality scoring and automatic recommendations for every employee.

  • Knowledge base

    A RAG pipeline that answers from documents, on PostgreSQL and pgvector.

  • Multi-tenant

    An isolated environment for every client and a superadmin observability panel.
